import hopsworks
import pandas as pd

# Connect to Hopsworks
project = hopsworks.login()
fs = project.get_feature_store()

# Load initial export
initial_df = pd.read_csv('data/initial_export.csv')

# Register and load version 1
customers_fg_v1 = fs.create_feature_group(
    name='customers1ae8a4',
    version=1,
    description='Initial export of customers table',
    primary_key=['row_id'],
    event_time='updated_at',
    online_enabled=False
)
customers_fg_v1.insert(initial_df, write_options={'wait_for_job': True})

# Load new export
new_df = pd.read_csv('data/reload/new_export.csv')

# Register and load version 2 (new schema)
customers_fg_v2 = fs.create_feature_group(
    name='customers1ae8a4',
    version=2,
    description='Full re-export of customers table with breaking schema changes',
    primary_key=['row_id'],
    event_time='updated_at',
    online_enabled=True  # Enable online access for version 2
)
customers_fg_v2.insert(new_df, write_options={'wait_for_job': True})

print('Feature groups created successfully.')
